# azion_bucket (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azion_bucket" "example" {
  name = "my-bucket-name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the bucket to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `last_editor` (String) Last editor of the bucket.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified timestamp of the bucket.
- `name` (String) Name of the bucket.
- `product_version` (String) Product version of the bucket.
- `workloads_access` (String) Access type for workloads: read_only, read_write, or restricted.
